tagline: Portraits, products and places in natural light

posts.title: A Morning With the Ferreira Family
content: We met at eight, before the park filled up. Three generations, one very patient dog, and forty minutes of soft light through the trees.
The gallery went out yesterday: 62 edited frames, with a short list of the ones I would print large.

posts.title: How I Light a Product Shoot With One Window
content: Most of my product work uses a north-facing window, a white board and a black board. That is the whole kit.
Move the white board closer to lift the shadows. Swap it for the black one when the object needs more shape. The post has a diagram for each setup.

posts.title: New: Half-Day Sessions for Small Shops
content: A half day covers about twenty products on a plain background, plus a handful of lifestyle frames for your home page.
Files arrive within a week, sized for your store and for print. Dates for next month are open on the booking page.

posts.title: What to Wear for a Portrait Session
content: Solid colors, layers, and nothing you would not wear on a normal good day. Bring one alternative and we will decide on the spot.
Avoid logos and very fine stripes. Both pull attention away from your face, which is the reason we are here.

pages.title: Northlight Studio
content: Northlight is the photo studio of Lucas Mendes. Portraits, products and places, photographed in natural light.
Sessions run Tuesday to Saturday in the studio or on location. See the portfolio, check the services, and book a date.

pages.title: Portfolio
content: A selection from the last two years: family and portrait sessions, product work for small shops, and interiors for architects and hosts.
Every gallery here is published with the client's permission. Ask for a full set if you want to see a complete session.

pages.title: Services
content: Portrait session, one hour, 25 edited photos. Family session, ninety minutes, 60 edited photos. Product half day, about twenty products.
Interiors and events are quoted per project. Every booking includes a short call before the day and a private online gallery after it.

pages.title: Book a Session
content: Tell me what you have in mind, a couple of dates that work, and where you would like to shoot. I reply within one working day.
A 30% deposit confirms the date. You can move it once, free of charge, up to a week before the session.

pages.title: Contact
content: Rua da Luz 118, second floor. Visits by appointment, Tuesday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00.
Write to hello@northlightstudio.com or use the form on the booking page.
